title_en: Stories of Modern China (16/20): The Last Storyteller
note_en: The 把 construction moves the object in front of the verb when the focus is on what happens to it: 把赵爷爷讲的每一个故事都写了下来 "wrote down every story Grandpa Zhao told." The verb after 把 can't stand alone; it needs a result or direction like 下来 or 成 (把这些传说整理成一本小书, "collect these legends into a little book"). English just says "write down the stories," but Chinese uses 把 to stress that something was done to them.
